abilities.name: oblivious
abilities.effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against captivate.

abilities.name: forewarn
abilities.effect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

abilities.name: dry-skin
abilities.effect: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain.  Increases damage from fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

kanto.flavorText: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

original-johto.flavorText: It has several different cry pat­ terns, each of which seems to have its own meaning.

hoenn.flavorText: A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

updated-johto.flavorText: It speaks a language similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.

original-unova.flavorText: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

kalos.flavorText: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Jynx walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.

updated-alola.flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.

swsh.flavorText: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.
